newest_source.result_used: ruled one-sheet exact-rank-three bound and its stated rough-trace obligation

mathematical_premises: Independent original-coordinate Gaussian padding preserves the probability-density cap <=1 and converges in L1 coordinatewise.
Product L1 distance is at most the sum of coordinate L1 distances, hence quadratic pushforwards converge in total variation.
Every two-dimensional orthogonal projection of a cap-one product law has density at most 2 (Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov product-marginal theorem).
For q(z)=z1^2+z2^2-z3^2 on q>0, F(s,theta,t)=sqrt(s)e_theta+t(e_theta_perp+e3) has Jacobian 1/2 and parametrizes the one-sheet level region.
The zero set of a nonzero real polynomial is Lebesgue-null.

partner_result_applied.application: sup_(eta,y) integral_[0,infinity) gamma_eta(s-y) dmu_Q(s) <= pi sqrt(2) for the exact-rank-three (+,+,-) one-sheet submeasure

new_result.scope: exact rank three, signature (+,+,-), majority-sign one-sheet side s>=0, arbitrary independent measurable cap-one coordinate densities
new_result.statement: For every interval I subset [0,infinity), P(Q in I)<=C_+|I| with C_+=(lambda1 lambda2 mu)^(-1/2) int_0^(2pi)(sin^2(theta)/lambda1+cos^2(theta)/lambda2+1/mu)^(-1/2)dtheta <= pi sqrt(2). Thus the positive-side submeasure has essential density <=pi sqrt(2).
